select_vet: Select a veterinarian from the list.
delete_body: Are you sure you want to delete this veterinarian? This cannot be undone.
copy_body: Would you like to copy the details from yur previous entry, or start with a blank form?
help_body: Fill in all fields and tap Add veterinarian to save a new record. Tap the calendar icon to choose a date of birth. Tap a name in the list to view and edit their details. Use the Update button to save changes. Use the Delete button to remove a record.
